usdRate.sourceName: Banco Nacional de Angola, reference exchange rate (taxa de referência, venda) USD
usdRate.note: BNA reference selling rate AOA 913 per US dollar on 30 October 2026 (the BNA website's exchange-rate feed); World Bank 2025 average AOA 912 (PA.NUS.FCRF).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, Angola inflation rate (from INE Angola, national CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: 8.43% year on year in September 2026 (8.78% in August), the lowest since April 2015; the INE Angola home page indicator panel shows the same 8.43% but its release page could not be read. World Bank 2025 average 20.2%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: INE CPI 8.43% (Sep 2026, via Trading Economics); World Bank CPI 20.2% in 2025; BNA governor expects 8.6% at end-2026
inflation_projection.note: Angola has no formal inflation target and averaged roughly 20% a year over 2021-2025, but inflation has fallen fast to about 8.5%, so 12% is used as a long-run planning rate between the two.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Angola interest rate (Banco Nacional de Angola, Taxa BNA)
policy_rate.note: Secondary source; the BNA site could not be read. The BNA cut its policy rate by 100 basis points to 14.75% on 15 September 2026, its third straight cut; next meeting 17 November 2026.

savings_account_rate.note: No published typical savings account rate was found. Searched the Banco Nacional de Angola site (a script-rendered app that could not be read), the Treasury debt office (UGD) portal and the securities exchange statistics pages, which showed no rendered figures.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit (depósito a prazo) rate was found. Searched the Banco Nacional de Angola site (a script-rendered app that could not be read), the Treasury debt office (UGD) portal and the securities exchange statistics pages, which showed no rendered figures.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate was found. Searched the Banco Nacional de Angola site (a script-rendered app that could not be read), the Treasury debt office (UGD) portal and the securities exchange statistics pages, which showed no rendered figures. The World Bank average deposit rate was 7.98% in 2025.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring-deposit product or rate was found for Angola.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 2025 average deposit rate 7.98% (7.40% in 2024), also shown by Trading Economics. The BNA policy rate has since been cut three times, to 14.75% in September 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; individuals can buy Treasury bills and bonds through banks and the securities exchange.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current 91-day Treasury bill (Bilhetes do Tesouro) auction yield could be read. Searched the Banco Nacional de Angola site (a script-rendered app that could not be read), the Treasury debt office (UGD) portal and the securities exchange statistics pages, which showed no rendered figures.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No current 5-year Treasury bond (Obrigações do Tesouro) yield could be read. Searched the Banco Nacional de Angola site (a script-rendered app that could not be read), the Treasury debt office (UGD) portal and the securities exchange statistics pages, which showed no rendered figures.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No current 10-year Treasury bond yield could be read. Searched the Banco Nacional de Angola site (a script-rendered app that could not be read), the Treasury debt office (UGD) portal and the securities exchange statistics pages, which showed no rendered figures.

tax_bank_interest.note: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries states that Angola's Investment Income Tax (Imposto sobre a Aplicação de Capitais) is generally 15%, or 10% for listed income including bond interest, and exempts interest on government-approved savings products up to AOA 500,000; it does not state the rate on bank deposit interest, and the tax authority (AGT) site did not respond.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: There is no government savings certificate for individuals; PwC Tax Summaries lists bond interest at the 10% Investment Income Tax rate (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/angola/corporate/taxes-on-corporate-income), but no retail savings-certificate product exists to apply it to.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Angola has a deposit guarantee fund (Fundo de Garantia de Depósitos), but its site could not be read (certificate error) and no other official page with the per-depositor limit was found.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card interest rate was found; the World Bank lending rate was 19.4% in 2025 and Trading Economics shows 15.75% in September 2026.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock index (the Angolan securities exchange lists only a few shares); S&P 500 as a global proxy (Trading Economics); World Bank deposit rate 7.98% (2025)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: global shares earn well below their record in dollars and the kwanza stays near AOA 913 per dollar, so returns trail deposits.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in kwanza terms (S&P 500 via Trading Economics); after-tax safe rate about 6.8% (World Bank deposit rate 7.98% less up to 15% Investment Income Tax)
equity_return_base.note: Angola has no diversified local equity index, so this is a global equity index in kwanza terms, capped at about 4 points over the after-tax average deposit rate (6.8% after 15% tax).

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity index (Trading Economics); long-run kwanza depreciation against the dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
equity_return_high.note: High case: global shares do well and the kwanza resumes faster depreciation, lifting returns in kwanza.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026 (Trading Economics); kwanza stable at AOA 912-913 per dollar in 2025-26 (BNA, World Bank)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: dollar gold drifts after the 2025-26 spike and the kwanza holds its value.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); expected kwanza depreciation
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises about 3% a year plus about 7% a year of kwanza depreciation, consistent with planning inflation of 12% against about 2.5% US inflation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); kwanza depreciation history (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold and faster kwanza depreciation, as in the 2016-2024 devaluation episodes.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: World Bank average deposit rate 7.98% (2025); BNA policy rate 14.75% and falling
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates fall with the policy rate and Investment Income Tax of about 10-15% is withheld.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: World Bank average deposit rate 7.98% (2025) less about 10% tax = 7.2%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at about today's average rate after Investment Income Tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BNA policy rate 14.75% (Trading Economics); World Bank deposit rate 7.98%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: savers lock in longer term deposits or Treasury bonds, which pay well above the average deposit rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The insurance regulator ARSEG publishes market statistics and complaint reports, but no industry-wide life insurance claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No regulator or government source with indicative term life premiums for Angola was found; ARSEG lists life insurance among voluntary insurance types but publishes no premium data.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay in Angola was found.

health_premium_table.note: No official or regulator data on private health insurance premiums by age in Angola was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: INE CPI 8.43% (Sep 2026, via Trading Economics); 5-year CPI average about 20%
goal_inflation_health.note: No health CPI figure could be read, so health goals use the long-run planning inflation rate of 12%, since private care is priced partly in imported goods and dollars.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: INE CPI September 2026: education +18.53% year on year (via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices are rising more than twice as fast as headline inflation, so 15% is used for education goals.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 62.6, women 67.7 (UN WPP estimate for 2026). World Bank 2024: 64.8 (men 62.3, women 67.3).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.46 (2025, World Bank), 6.1 (2040) and 8.0 (2065, populationpyramid.net/angola/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The social security institute (INSS) site could not be read (certificate error), and the ISSA and ILO country profiles returned 403; no readable official source for the old-age pension age was found.

retirement_age_government.note: No readable official source for the retirement age of civil servants was found (INSS and public administration pages could not be read).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: World Bank average deposit rate 7.98% (2025); BNA policy rate falling (Trading Economics)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates fall further as the BNA keeps cutting.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: World Bank average deposit rate 7.98% (2025) less about 10-15% Investment Income Tax = 6.8-7.2%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept just below the after-tax average deposit rate, the only safe-rate figure that could be sourced.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BNA policy rate 14.75% (Trading Economics); World Bank deposit rate 7.98%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a retiree holds longer term deposits or Treasury bonds at rates above the average deposit rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of deposits and foreign equity in kwanza terms.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Fixed income base 7%; equity base 11% (global index in kwanza)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: mostly kwanza deposits and bonds with some global equity, given the very small local stock market.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning mix if the kwanza depreciates faster.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension amount was found; the INSS and ministry pages could not be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension eligibility rules were found (INSS and ILO pages could not be read).

gratuity_rule.note: No readable source for an end-of-service payment on retirement or resignation under the General Labour Law (Lei Geral do Trabalho, Law 12/23) was found.

public_pension_scheme.note: Angola has a contributory social security system run by INSS (PwC Tax Summaries: employees pay 3% and employers 8% of gross pay, https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/angola/individual/other-taxes), but no readable source for its pension age, qualifying period or indexation was found.

savings_account.note: Offered by banks; no published average rate was found.

fdr_3m.note: No published average rate was found.

fdr_1y.note: The World Bank average deposit rate was 7.98% in 2025.

dps.note: No monthly recurring-deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Issued by the Ministry of Finance; individuals buy them through banks or exchange members. No current yield could be read.

tbond_5y.note: Treasury bonds are traded on the Angolan securities exchange. No current yield could be read.

tbond_10y.note: A 10-year benchmark yield could not be confirmed.

equity_fund.note: No diversified equity mutual or index fund for retail investors was found; the Angolan securities exchange lists only a few shares.

gold.note: No retail market for investment gold bars or coins was found.

insuranceRegulator.name: Agência Angolana de Regulação e Supervisão de Seguros (ARSEG)

insuranceComplaints.name: ARSEG, apresentar reclamação
insuranceComplaints.note: Complain to the insurer (or its customer ombudsman) first; ARSEG also takes complaints by e-mail and phone.

pensionScheme.name: Instituto Nacional de Segurança Social (INSS)
pensionScheme.note: Contributory social security: employees pay 3% and employers 8% of gross pay.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministério da Saúde, Serviço Nacional de Saúde
publicHealthCover.note: Runs the public National Health Service facilities.
